title: X-LAB DAWNBREAKER time-trial bike specification
notes: Official mainland specification for the time-trial bike in its R7170 Di2 / BRANTA DAWNBREAKER build: 9.08 kg without pedals in size S; X-LAB DAWNBREAKER carbon frame of Toray T1100×M40X; X-LAB TT carbon fork with 12×100 mm thru-axle and flat-mount brakes; X-LAB TT carbon base bar with Vision Metron TFE PRO extensions; 350 mm X-LAB TT carbon seatpost; Shimano Dura-Ace Di2 R9160 shift buttons and R9180 brake levers with 105 Di2 R7150 derailleurs, FC-R7100 50/34T and CS-R7101 11–34T; BBT47 86-24 bottom bracket; Dura-Ace R9270 brakes with SM-RT70 rotors; BRANTA DAWNBREAKER TT 80 mm front wheel and closed disc rear; Michelin Pro 5 700×28C tires; 100 kg maximum load. Four sizes S–XL; stack/reach S 490/395, M 493/410, L 512/428, XL 540/448 mm. No maximum tire clearance, storage system or race-legality statement is given.
